items.original_weakness: Ambiguous person/admission linkage and missing containing-admission condition
items.current_resolution: Verified person mapping; exactly one containing admission; explicit exclusions; no arbitrary tie resolution.

items.original_weakness: Profile grouping loses unit identity and can arbitrarily select donor attributes
items.current_resolution: Physical-unit ledger retained; simultaneous MAIN event; every factor requires all units known and agreeing; parity additionally all female.

items.original_weakness: Count restricted/anchored incorrectly or includes index ties
items.current_resolution: Strictly earlier physical units in same verified admission; all index ties excluded; distinct index and follow-up scopes.

items.original_weakness: Fractional storage/Hb gaps and SAS missing values assigned to lowest category
items.current_resolution: Shared exhaustive category rules; unknown stays unknown; female-only parity.

items.original_weakness: Distinct person-age rows may count a person repeatedly
items.current_resolution: One verified person at first eligible event; denominators distinguish persons/admissions/events/physical units/measurement rows.
Containing-admission eligibility prevents this silent coercion; negative/time-conflict states are not reset tozero.

items.original_weakness: Missing sedative numeric value becomes false under >0
items.current_resolution: Adapter preserves missing values; upstream missing-as-zero cannot be reversed without verified source definitions.

items.original_weakness: Shifted level intervals or independent-endpoint SEs used for changes
items.current_resolution: Direct same-fit endpoint contrasts; stable design-difference trajectory arithmetic; covariance-aware uncertainty and independent reconstruction.

items.original_weakness: Whole-curve significance or within-category significance substituted for differences in change
items.current_resolution: Separate endpoint heterogeneity and whole-trajectory tests, all pairwise change contrasts, frozen Holm families and explicit unavailable hypotheses.

items.original_weakness: Repeated measurements/events require appropriate uncertainty and finite-sample handling
items.current_resolution: Uniform GLS-whitened CR2, person clustering, Satterthwaite/HTZ, exact structural certificates, fixed target span; all252 final sample jobs still pending.

items.original_weakness: Different before/after events and unaccounted repeated persons
items.current_resolution: Same paired events/approved windows/equal event weight/person clustering; direct three-metric covariance, arithmetic identity certificate, preserved estimated-zero covariance, strict scale-sensitive validation.

items.original_weakness: Unverified dose semantics, unit compatibility, overlap arithmetic, broad product classes and timing
items.current_resolution: Measurement-relative treatment windows can include post-index treatment. Code execution and robust inference do not certify inherited clinical covariates. Source resolution or explicit prospective methodological amendment required.

items.original_weakness: Planned units mistaken for native units; undocumented artifact/missing codes
items.current_resolution: No unsupported conversion or clinical trimming adopted. Native FIO2(u)/VE(u) definitions and coding policy remain unresolved.

items.original_weakness: Required summaries lack verified source mapping or pre-window recording interface
items.current_resolution: No invented diagnosis conversion, ward-hospital mapping or cadence claims; unavailable reasons carried into aggregate contract.

items.original_weakness: Insufficient saved covariance/DF forces later refitting
items.current_resolution: Working anchor covariance and robust cross-category covariance/normalized moment archive retained with fit/design/profile/method binding; future contrasts restricted to certified span.

items.original_weakness: Partial/stale outputs or interrupted SAS mistaken for completion
items.current_resolution: Owned processes, durable failure halts, supervisor capacity, separate attempts, receipt-bound selection, exact typed output collection and incomplete-release rejection; complete252 remains pending.

items.original_weakness: Only prototypes or subset of final jobs validated
items.current_resolution: Complete252-job sample batch, all report bundles, resource capacity plan, frozen three-stage interface, consumer contract and source scientific resolution required before Lucas launches full.

items.original_weakness: Global numerical error envelope prevents certification of a sample contrast despite positive denominator and consistent arithmetic.
items.current_resolution: Conditional directional construction bounds with rigorous re-evaluation transfer preserve original central arithmetic and threshold. Original M0012 remains rejected; no silent acceptance or methodological substitution.
